protocol.sampling_rule: Test manifest, uniformly without replacement within each class; all if fewer
protocol.image: EXIF-corrected RGB, bilinear resize 192×192, center crop 160×160, float64 in [0,1]
protocol.boundary: Circular for explicit shifts and phase average; no wrap in real image gradients
protocol.noise: Zero-mean Gaussian white noise, sigma 0.03, matched across transforms, no clipping
protocol.private_source_note: Prepared research test images stay local; no photographs are redistributed.
